definitions: A French high fashion luxury goods manufacturer established in 1837, specializing in leather, lifestyle accessories, home furnishings, perfumery, jewellery, watches and ready-to-wear.
In Greek mythology, the son of Zeus and Maia, messenger of the gods, and god of trade, thieves, travellers, sports, athletes, and border crossings, guide to the Underworld.
examples: Hermès is known for its iconic scarves.
The myth of Hermès is fascinating.
